_doc: Legal units (article / note / clause) cited by the explanation templates. Filled BY HAND (Navid).
Claude never writes legal text here. Entries with status TODO(legal) are placeholders.
id          unique string, e.g. 'VAT1400-A9-C1' (free form, never reused)
title       short Persian title shown with the citation
body        the unit's text, copied verbatim from the source
valid_from  first day in force, Jalali YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive)
valid_to    LAST day in force, Jalali YYYY-MM-DD (INCLUSIVE, same convention as the catalog's
ExpirationDate), or null if still in force. The loader converts it to a half-open end.
source_url  where the text was taken from
applies_to  list of finding codes this unit may be cited for: T2 T3 T4 T6 NOT_IN_CATALOG NOT_IN_FORCE
status      'reviewed' once checked by a human, or 'TODO(legal)' for a placeholder
